side_notes: Under-coverage: the nominalized-subject defect (results__a2f1, e.g. 'Identification is within firm') was caught by only one of three agents and has no corroborating duplicate to merge against. A human should confirm it is a real, exemplar-anchored gap (anchor a1-f3) rather than an idiosyncratic single-agent catch, since it survives uncorroborated.

Under-coverage: the surviving set is almost entirely sentence/clause-level register (diction, sentence length, negation, hedging, metaphor, number-attachment). Subsection-level results ORGANIZATION is touched only lightly (repeated-distinction a1f12, finding-first order a3f21, rider-everywhere a3f18, display-classification a3f14). If our results prose has larger-scale ordering/structure gaps beyond these, they may be under-covered by this principle set.

Note for human routing (not a cull): three survivors lean closest to the absolute boundary because they name a count drawn from the exemplar register -- 'one fact per short declarative' (a1f3), 'single hedge per clause' (a3f5), and 'one or two numbers, route the rest to the table' (a1f16). Each is exemplar-anchored and stated relatively (a3-f4, a1-f9, a2-f14 respectively) so they pass F1/F2, but a human should confirm the count reflects the exemplar and is not hardened into a fixed cap.

judge_side_notes: All 28 principles carry type 'results'; the '8 types' framing did not apply to this batch, so there were no cross-type twins to merge - only one genuine within-type duplicate surfaced.

Only merge: results__a3f14 + results__a3f27 - both target self-referential metadiscourse (narrating 'This is a descriptive comparison' / 'the register in which we read them') with the same fix: make the move or state the claim directly instead of narrating it. Kept a3f14 as canonical (stronger, complete-sentence exemplars; equally clear trigger; finding count tied 1-1).

Many principles share exemplar sentences ('serves here as an anchor', 'What the event study adds is the round trip', 'a comparability limit we disclose') because the SAME multiply-flawed sentences were flagged by different analyses under DIFFERENT devices. These were deliberately NOT merged - each carries a distinct fix (e.g. a1f17 plain re-estimation verb vs a3f9 literal closer vs a3f26 plain emphasis adverb; a1f15 drop disclosure-verb vs a3f19 nominalization-to-verb).

Borderline pairs examined and kept separate as distinct devices: a1f12 vs a3f18 (re-arguing a methodological distinction across paragraphs vs a recurring multi-part hedge-tail); a3f5 vs a3f18 (intra-sentence hedge stacking vs cross-sentence rider recurrence); a3f2 vs a3f7 (figurative phrasing vs elevated-but-literal noun 'universe'); a2f1 vs a3f19 vs a3f23 (abstract nominalized copula-subject vs action-as-labeled-category vs personified vivid actor); a1f3 vs a1f13 vs a1f16 (clause-chaining vs appositive suspension vs statistic pile-up).

Few additional merges remained because the upstream had already consolidated same-construction findings across analyses a1/a2/a3 - visible as the multi-finding principles a3f2 (a1-f4,a3-f5), a1f3 (a1-f5,a3-f4), a2f11 (a2-f6,a3-f9), a3f29 (a2-f7,a3-f8).
